name: doxy
description: Rasmus's doxyme workflow skills, one step of the flow each: /doxy:feature (a product person's idea to vetted Jira tickets), /doxy:design (idea to a team brief), /doxy:ticket (brief to Jira), /doxy:implement (ticket to a draft MR), /doxy:review (Apps/SDK architecture review), /doxy:debug (bug report to a post mortem). Briefs and post mortems go to ~/.claude/specs.
